Acceptance_Criteria: TE HDSCS AMP MCP 6.3/4.8K 2-position sealed family or approved equivalent
4.0 mm2 feed maintained through service interface
4.0 mm2 dedicated return maintained through service interface
Selected contact explicitly supports actual 4.0 mm2 wire and insulation diameter
Selected contact/housing continuous rating exceeds measured pump steady current with thermal margin
Measured pump inrush does not create unacceptable heating/arcing/contact damage
Mated connector voltage drop acceptable at representative pump current
Connector/contact temperature acceptable at representative current and ambient
Cavity mapping prevents reversed pump polarity
Pump 1 and Pump 2 cannot be accidentally cross-connected where both fitted
Exact pump-side connector/pigtail identified and documented
Any conductor reduction below 4.0 mm2 is explicitly justified by pump-native design/current evidence
Connector mounted outside direct fuel immersion and away from excessive heat unless specifically rated
Connector and pigtail supported so pump vibration is not carried into terminals
If direct PMU selected exact PMU HW/output/terminal/current/thermal evidence all PASS
If external relay/SSR selected switching hardware and protection are frozen and tested
Fuse/electronic protection coordinated to conductor connector pump and switching device
Correct tooling conductor brush seal compression retention and pull-test evidence
Main harness remains serviceable without cutting when pump/pigtail is replaced
Applicable FPIF-001 through FPIF-019 PASS
